selection: random.Random(20260916); 10 Seen + 10 Unseen from official full lists, excluding all previous 10 gamefiles; selected before outcomes.
hint_generation_scope: Real-time at every reached state, independently within each arm.
hint_input: Same public task, current observation, latest up to two observation/executed-action pairs and full admissible action space as Student.

levels.L1: Existing approved light directional prompt unchanged; flaws are not edited away.
levels.L2: Previously reviewed v3 partial analysis and hypotheses, no definite next action.
levels.L3: New definition: explicit next-action recommendation from public information, NO ORACLE. Historical oracle L3 is not this arm.

cache: No cross-run hint reuse; preserve every actual request and visible output.
format_error_policy: Record malformed output; execute exactly the action produced by the existing matched_reasoning parser. No resampling or correction.
hint_error_policy: Retry transport/incomplete responses up to four times with distinct seeds; record failures. Do not silently turn a hinted arm into a no-hint arm.

kl.prefix_source: All 30 no-hint Base independent trajectories: previous 10 plus additional 20; original sampled token IDs.
secondary: Teacher Top32 plus aggregated remaining tail forward KL
kl.weights: Same original Qwen3-4B for all distributions, eval mode, no gradient updates.
kl.hint_input: Same task/state/recent two observation-action pairs/full action space as Base; no current sampled response/prefix or future observation supplied to GLM.
kl.exact_state_hint_reuse: May reuse an existing completed hint only if same level/system hash/public JSON/generation seed and API configuration; otherwise generate a new hint.
kl.vocabulary: All model output vocabulary entries; no top-k renormalization for primary KL.

api_concurrency: Up to 60 live rollout hints plus 64 prefix-hint requests = 124 total maximum.
